Anya Patel: Quick sync — I sketched a dependency map for Q3 roadmap. Main ask: align infra (Dedicated pools), model onboarding (eng-ml), and Console rollout timing.
Keenan O'Rourke: Link? can we get the diagram? also need headcount estimates for infra changes :eyes:
Anya Patel: https://redwood.app/s/diagrams/q3-dep-map — top-level constraints: 1) Dedicated capacity increase (infra) 2) Model quantization & validation (eng-ml) 3) Console exposes rollout controls (product)
Marco Ruiz: For Dedicated capacity, SRE needs a 3-week procurement + 2-week validation window. That puts infra earliest close-of-week 8/20.
Jen Lin: Console work is blocked on backend feature flag API (#FF-221). If that lands by 8/1 we can do a 2-week UI sprint and ship canary 8/21.
Ravi Shah: ML needs model QA and evals. Best estimate: 4 weeks after quantization PR is merged. Current work depends on kernel selection, so timeline is variable.
Laura Gomez: Customer asks: two enterprise pilots (Acme, Zephyr) want dedicated SLA by Sept. They need opt-in early August. That compresses everything.
Keenan O'Rourke: So critical path looks like: FF-221 merge -> Console canary -> Dedicated infra validation -> Model QA -> Pilot opt-in. Anything to shorten?
Anya Patel: Options to shave time: A) Feature flag backend scoped to minimal API (merge earlier) B) Ship Console with toggle disabled for pilot customers (partial UX) C) Use existing shared capacity for pilots temporarily (ops risk)
Marco Ruiz: A and C are feasible. C requires formal risk signoff from security (esp. data isolation). We can run pilots on shared with egress rules.
Jen Lin: A is the least risky but needs a backend owner to prioritize. Who can pick up FF-221?
Ravi Shah: I can allocate a dev for 20% to help with tests and model validation but not backend.
Laura Gomez: Sales would prefer C (fastest). They can accept temporary extra NDA and SSO scoping.
Keenan O'Rourke: Proposal: prioritize minimal FF-221 scope to unblock console. Simultaneously request SRE to provision a temporary shared pool for pilots with strict network controls. Then parallelize model QA with canary.
Anya Patel: Decision checkpoint: Aug 5 — if FF-221 not merged, fallback to plan C only if security signoff obtained by Aug 7. OKR impact: missing pilot SLA loses mid-Q revenue; need Exec approval.
Marco Ruiz: Noted. I'll start procurement and draft security controls doc.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag-service v1.14 -> staging at 2028-07-28T02:00Z
Jen Lin: I'll cut a slim PR for FF-221 this week for review. cc @Ravi for tests.
Ravi Shah: Will review and slot model evals to run in parallel with UI sprints.
Laura Gomez: I'll ping Acme & Zephyr with tentative opt-in dates and the temporary shared-pool plan.
Anya Patel: Thanks — I'll update the dependency map and create the milestone tracker (owner/action/dates). We should reconvene Mon Aug 4 for go/no-go.
Keenan O'Rourke: :thumbsup:
